details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan workflows
B. Implement / review-autofix workflows
C. Orchestrate / validate workflows
D. Documentation / README / operator guidance
E. Other — reply with the exact workflow, script, or file path you want changed (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want in that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug / incorrect behavior
B. Reduce flakiness / retries / stuck runs
C. Improve speed / token cost / API efficiency
D. Add or change functionality
E. Improve logs / comments / docs
F. Other — describe the exact before/after result you want (RECOMMENDED)
Q3. What should count as success for this issue?
Choices:
A. A specific failing workflow run / PR / issue example is fixed
B. A specific observable before/after behavior is achieved (RECOMMENDED)
C. A named file/workflow is updated in a specific way
D. Other — provide a short acceptance criterion or example
